title: Step 2 - Motion Loader Revamp (Per-Motion NPZ Support)
goal: Enable loading new per-motion NPZ format with variable trajectory lengths while preserving old stacked-format compatibility.

changes: Reworked MotionLoader to support two input formats: legacy stacked arrays and per-motion dict keys (motion0, motion1, ...).
Added parsing and validation for per-motion object-dict payloads stored in NPZ.
Added strict key/shape checks for required motion fields: joint_pos, joint_vel, body_pos_w, body_quat_w, body_lin_vel_w, body_ang_vel_w.
Added optional action/actions support in per-motion mode with consistency checks across all motions.
Added per-trajectory length tracking via trajectory_time_step_total tensor.
Switched to true ragged trajectory storage (no temporal padding) with gather helpers that resolve (trajectory_id, time_step) to flat frame indices.
Kept MotionCommand/reward call-site behavior unchanged while moving MotionLoader access to explicit gather methods.
Updated adaptive sampling and episode step wrap logic in MotionCommand to use per-trajectory lengths instead of a single global length.
Updated replay wrap condition to use selected trajectory length (trajectory_time_step_total) so variable-length motions replay correctly.
Switched ONNX exporter reference extraction to trajectory-based loader API (get_trajectory_data(0)) so export does not depend on stacked padded tensors.
Added conversion utility (step 1) that rewrites old stacked NPZ data into motion0/motion1/... object-dict format with native per-motion lengths preserved.

accepted_formats: legacy: top-level keys like joint_pos/joint_vel/body_* with shapes [N,T,...] or [T,...]
new: top-level motion keys motion0/motion1/... where each entry is a dict with per-motion arrays [T,...]
new_behavior.variable_lengths: Supported in new format without padding. Per-env wrap/resample and frame lookup use true per-trajectory lengths.
new_behavior.sampling: Adaptive bin sampling maps bins against each env's selected trajectory length.
new_behavior.action_key_handling: Either all motions provide action/actions, or none; mixed presence raises an error.

notes: Existing stacked motion files continue to load unchanged.
APIs consumed by observation/reward/action terms remain unchanged.
Per-motion files with inconsistent body count or joint dimensions across motions raise explicit errors.

validation.runtime_note: Direct runtime instantiation of MotionLoader was not executed in this shell because Isaac/Omniverse module omni.kit is unavailable outside simulator environment.
